smyx-infant-suffocation-risk-detection-analysis v1.0.2

- Updated SKILL.md to version 1.0.2 with minor text and formatting adjustments.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Made internal script changes in smyx_common/scripts/dao.py and util.py.

- Overhauled SKILL.md: greatly simplified user interaction by removing all requirements for providing or managing open-id; user identity handling is now fully automatic and internal.
- Updated instructions and examples for easier usage—users need only provide input files or URLs; no identity prompts will be shown.
- Strengthened privacy and security guidelines: identity values are never surfaced to the user and should not be referenced in outputs or examples.
- Clarified that historical report queries and analysis results are always linked and fetched via the internal identity system, without user intervention.
- Improved output formatting instructions for historical report tables and streamlined documentation structure for better clarity.
- Removed obsolete or redundant internal file references and consolidated configuration guidelines.

smyx-infant-suffocation-risk-detection-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release of infant suffocation risk detection and analysis skill.
- Real-time analysis of crib monitoring video to detect infant sleep posture and whether mouth/nose is occluded by objects.
- Automatic alerts with risk level (medium/high/critical) sent to parents' mobile app when dangerous posture or occlusion is detected.
- 24/7 monitoring, alarm triggers for prone sleeping or mouth/nose occlusion.
- Strict open-id acquisition and API interface use for report queries and video analysis.
- Markdown table export for historical risk reports via cloud API only, with direct report access links.
